title: Wire Email/set into JMAP dispatcher
description: Email/set create is fully implemented in crates/mail/src/email/set.rs and tested, but handle_email_set is never registered in the route_method() dispatcher in server.rs. JMAP clients cannot compose or post articles via JMAP today. Fix: register Email/set in the dispatcher so clients can create new articles (posts to newsgroups) via JMAP Email/set {create}. Destroy returns notPermitted (immutable articles). Update only permits keywords changes.
